page: Microsoft Azure NC24lds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family. It is powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 72.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 3.0 GB of memory per core.

This server type is equipped with four GPUs and includes 1980 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is also capable of utilizing Premium Storage. The integration of local NVMe SSD storage provides high-speed local data access, though the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration presents a tradeoff between high GPU density and system memory, as the 3.0 GB per core ratio is classified as a low-memory configuration. This makes the instance suitable for workloads that require significant GPU acceleration and local storage speed but do not demand massive system memory footprints, such as specific machine learning inference tasks, parallel rendering, and GPU-bound compute workloads.
